Meanings are from the eBL dictionary (largely based on CDA – Black, George & Postgate, A Concise Dictionary of Akkadian). Stem-specific meanings (G, D, Š, N…) follow the main gloss.

-ma I

  • Meaning: ptcl. and conj. (-me Am.; NA, NB rarely after e or im; NA before - ni (cf. ayyakamēni, matimeni); -mu NB, occas. jB, esp. after u)
  • Lines: 234-235
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-ma%20I

-mi I

  • Meaning: suff. in citation of dir. speech (cf. GAG §123c)
  • Lines: 80
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/-mi%20I

-ya I

abunnatu I

  • Meaning: "umbilical cord, navel" Bab. [LI.DUR] also transf. "centre", "central point" of land, army; "socket" of chariot, spade
  • Logograms: LI.DUR
  • Lines: 163-164
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/abunnatu%20I

abāku I

  • Meaning: "to lead away" OA, NA, M/NB
    • G: (a/u) OA "take (commodities) to"; + vent. "fetch" commodities, animals; often with ippāniya ("myself in person"); Bab. as OA "take to", + vent. "fetch" objects, animals, also people, NB "hale" witness, debtor; NB ana kaspi a. 'take away for silver' = "buy"
    • Gt: Mari "lead away"
    • D: Mari "dispatch, forward" goods; jB "push away, displace"; NA "shift" work onto s.o.
    • Š: jB "have s.o. bring" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G j/NB
  • Lines: 64-65
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81ku%20I

abātu I

  • Meaning: "to destroy"
    • G: (a/u, O/jB also i'abbat, i'but (cf. GAG §97h)) objects, buildings; living beings; OA "ruin (economically)"
    • D: "destroy completely" objects, parts of body, living beings; jB occas. + eli instead of acc.
    • Dt: pass. of D [GUL.MEŠ]
    • Š: caus. of G OB(lit.)
    • N: pass. of G (forms cf. GAG §97j)
  • Logograms: GUL.MEŠ
  • Lines: 220-221, 225-226
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ab%C4%81tu%20I

adi I

  • Meaning: "until, as far as" [EN]
  • Logograms: EN, A.RÁ
  • Lines: 99-100
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/adi%20I

ahu II

  • Logograms: GÚ
  • Lines: 35-36
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ahu%20II

akalu I

  • Meaning: —
  • Logograms: NINDA, NINDA.HI.A, NINDA.MEŠ, NINDA
  • Lines: 87, 90-91, 96-97, 99-100
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/akalu%20I

akālu I

  • Meaning: "to eat"
    • G: (a/u) [GU7]
    • Gtn: iter. of G [GU7.GU7]
    • Gt: of lands "ravage each other"; of stars "cover, absorb each other"
    • Š: caus. of G [GU7] "make" men, animals, fire "eat, feed on, consume" food, medication, goods, booty, lands; "steep" an object in liquid; OA "satisfy" a claimant; jB stat. "is infected" with a disease
    • Št: [GU7] OB math. "multiply together", freq. "square" measured lengths N pass. of G [GU7]
  • Logograms: GU7, GU7.GU7
  • Lines: 90-91, 96-97, 99-100
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81lu%20I

akāšu I

  • Meaning: "to walk, go" Bab., O/MA
    • G: (u/u) [DU] of messenger, person, snake
    • Gt: "go away"
    • D: "drive away, expel" person, disease, demon; ~ "press, push away" part of liver; OA stat. of tablet "is mislaid" ?
    • Dtn: iter. of D
    • Dt: pass. of D "be expelled, driven off"
  • Logograms: DU
  • Lines: 140, 144, 200-201
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/ak%C4%81%C5%A1u%20I

alaktu I

  • Meaning: pl. cf. alkakātu "way, course" [A.RÁ]
  • Logograms: A.RÁ
  • Lines: 202-203
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/alaktu%20I

alādu I

  • Meaning: "to give birth (to)" [Ù.TU; occas. TU]
    • G: (a/i)
    • Gtn: iter. of G [Ù.TU.MEŠ]
    • Dt: pass. of D "be begotten"
    • Š: caus. of G
    • N: pass. of G children mala waldū u iwwalladū "as many as are or shall be born"
  • Logograms: Ù.TU, TU, Ù.TU.MEŠ
  • Lines: 18-19, 47, 83-84, 186-187, 234-235
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81du%20I

alāku I

  • Meaning: "to go"
    • G: (illak, illik; perf. ittalak (cf. GAG §97n)) [DU]
    • Gtn: [DU.DU] "go, come repeatedly; roam about, wander", muttallik mūši [LÚ.GE6.A.DU.DU; (LÚ.)GE6.DU.DU] 'who walks around during the night' = "night-watchman"; OB of leg muscles "twitch persistently"
    • Gt: "go off, away" (cf. GAG §92e) differentiation between pret. of Gt and perf. of G difficult
    • Š: caus. of G [DU] with abstr. noun ending in -ūtu or adv. "make s.o./s.th. (become)" s.th.; stat. "is appropriate, suitable" [TÚM.MA]
  • Logograms: DU, IGI.DU, DU.DU
  • Lines: 4-5, 54-55, 56-57, 141-142, 146, 175-176
  • eBL: https://www.ebl.lmu.de/dictionary/al%C4%81ku%20I

  • Lines: 54-55

amāru I

    • D: rare; OA "examine" metal; cf. mummertu
    • Š: caus. of G
    • Št: "make s.o. meet" s.o.
    • N: pass. of G [IGI; IGI.LÁ]
    • Ntn: iter. of N 1
  • Logograms: IGI, IGI.DU8, IGI.LÁ

bašû I

  • Meaning: "to be (at hand, available); exist" [GÁL]
    • G: (i/i; no perf.) "be in existence, available"; of eyes, ears "be fixed on, attentive"; of task, responsibility "lie with" s.o.; of power, characteristic "be owned" by s.o.; pret. ibši "was/were" (emphatic); M/NA pres. ibašši, also pl., as adv. ~ "really, in fact; some"; j/NB mala bašû "as much as there is available, everything, everybody"; adi lā bašê (infin.) 'until non-existence' of destruction, disease
    • Š: "bring into being"
    • N: ingress. of G
    • Ntn: "happen repeatedly"
  • Logograms: GÁL
  • Lines: 6, 53, 110-111

"put in place, install" door; "launch" ship; "post" guard; "install" gate-sculptures; "settle" inhabitants; "cause to catch" fire, "ignite"; "make s.o. (start to) do s.th."
    • Štn: pass. of Š NB of work "be started on"
    • Št2: "make o.s. take", OA "gather up" silver; OB "get" troops, animals, tools "ready"; "execute" plan, decision
    • N: pass. of G [DAB]; ~ Gt OA, OB "seize one another", "litigate"
    • Ntn: ~ Gt "be interlocked, grown together"; of teeth "lock each other"
